{{Quote|Our last supreme commander got vaporized. I hope you're luckier than her&hellip;|Nae Nuuv|<ref name="Jedi Commander" />}}
A '''Jedi''' served as [[Supreme Commander (Jedi)|Supreme Commander]] of all [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Battle of Corellia]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]<ref name="Jedi Commander" /> in [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> The Jedi fought alongside the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] in defense of Corellia, though she was [[Death/Legends|killed]], and the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nae Nuuv]] claimed that her body had been vaporized during the fighting. The Jedi was succeeded as Supreme Commander by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]].<ref name="Jedi Commander" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unidentified Jedi commander was first mentioned in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] Knight class mission "Jedi Commander" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]]. The Jedi's name and [[Species/Legends|species]] were not identified.<ref name="Jedi Commander" />
